libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: No extra Maven dependency, environment variable, or system property is required for baseline coverage. Start and cleanly stop the prepared MicrocksContainer, import a small classpath OpenAPI fixture, then exercise mock endpoint lookup, HTTP access, invocation verification, and TestRequest/TestResult APIs. Postman and asynchronous ensemble paths require additional optional runtime containers or brokers and should not be assumed for the initial scaffold.

deterministic_setup.reason:
The published artifact depends on Testcontainers but not on a Microcks server; its documented usage constructs and starts a Microcks Uber container. Version 0.5.0 webhook support requires Microcks 1.14.0 or later. [POM](https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/microcks/microcks-testcontainers/
...[truncated]

risks: Container startup is relatively slow and requires Docker; use bounded readiness and test timeouts.
Native Image verification may expose unsupported Testcontainers or HTTP/reflection paths; local Gradle and Native Image results remain authoritative.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Meaningful coverage requires starting Microcks in its Uber Docker distribution.
